title: The backlog.py usage block shows set taking several ids and which options a batch refuses, as set --help does
goal: the module usage block of _tools/backlog.py shows backlog.py set ID [ID...] and says the per-item options are refused with several ids, so kbtools.py's entry for backlog.py set tells the same

run:
import sys,re
t=open("_tools/backlog.py",encoding="utf-8").read()
i=t.find("  backlog.py set ID")
blk=t[i:i+1800]
ok=bool(re.search(r"backlog\.py set ID(\s|\.|\[)*ID\.\.\.|set ID ID", blk)) and "one item" in blk
print(ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-f7kaebel review (S3): _tools/backlog.py:86 still reads `set ID [...]`; ST-fblg3yso updated tools.md and the argparse help, not this usage block, which kbtools.py reads for its backlog.py set entry. Check fails on the base today.
